result.title: Sparse Attention for Visual Generation: Toward Algorithm-System Co-Design
result.summary: Rapid advances in image and video generation have enabled high-fidelity synthesis at higher resolutions and longer durations, making the quadratic cost of dense self-attention a major bottleneck as visual token sequences grow. Sparse attention seeks to preserve generation quality at lower computational cost by retaining informative query-key interactions and omitting less consequential ones, with end-to-end gains depending on the cost of constructing sparse support and the efficiency with which the system maps the resulting workload to hardware. We survey sparse attention for visual generation through a 4+1+3 analytical framework that links algorithmic design to system implementation. The framework examines how static and dynamic methods use source information and the evidence derived from it to decide which interactions to retain and at what granularity, while accounting for the roles of reuse in reducing repeated computation and correction in compensating for omitted contributions. We relate these algorithmic choices to their implementation on hardware through the framework's three system dimensions of data organization, execution, and dataflow. We summarize common evaluation metrics and discuss open challenges and research directions, providing researchers and practitioners with a reference for the joint design of sparse attention algorithms and systems.

AI.brief_summary: 该综述以「4+1+3」框架梳理视觉生成中的稀疏注意力：静态与动态方法如何依据来源信息及由证据判断保留哪些 query-key 交互与粒度，并讨论复用与误差补偿，再对应到数据组织、执行与数据流等系统维度及评测指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按证据动态筛选 token 交互、以 reuse/correction 补偿稀疏化漏失的思路，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与 latent 注意力结构（内容、位置、缓存）分析提供借鉴线索，需核查能否迁移到推理期状态更新。
